skill_description: Quantum-Inspired microservice placement optimizer for Kubernetes and Docker Compose. Analyzes service topology and runs QIEA/GA/Greedy solvers to find the optimal node assignment that minimizes cross-zone latency and resource overflow.

auth.description: IBM Cloud IAM Bearer token for the QUBOB API server. Store this in your watsonx Orchestrate credential vault under the key QUBOB_API_KEY.

actions.description: Analyzes Kubernetes or Docker Compose manifests for a cluster. Returns the service dependency graph, RTT latency matrix, and top-5 bottleneck edges. Run this before optimizing to understand the current topology.

input_parameters.name: cluster_id
input_parameters.description: The logical name of the cluster to analyze (e.g. 'staging-k8s', 'prod-k8s', 'demo'). Must be registered on the QUBOB server.

input_parameters.name: manifest_type
input_parameters.description: Format of the manifests: 'auto' detects automatically, 'kubernetes' forces K8s parsing, 'compose' forces Docker Compose parsing.

output_parameters.name: n_services
output_parameters.description: Total services discovered in the manifests

output_parameters.name: bottlenecks
output_parameters.description: Top-5 call edges with highest RPS (most latency-sensitive)

output_parameters.name: latency_matrix
output_parameters.description: N_nodes × N_nodes round-trip time matrix in milliseconds

actions.example_prompt: Analyze the staging Kubernetes cluster topology
actions.example_response_summary: Found 12 services and 3 nodes in staging-k8s. Top bottleneck: api-gateway → order-service at 450 RPS.

actions.description: Runs the quantum-inspired (QIEA), classical GA, or greedy solver on the cluster manifests. Returns the optimal placement plan: which node each service should run on, QUBO cost breakdown, and latency reduction vs the naive baseline. The plan is cached server-side.

input_parameters.name: cluster_id
input_parameters.description: The logical name of the cluster to optimize

input_parameters.name: algorithm
input_parameters.description: Which solver to use: 'qiea' = Quantum-Inspired EA (best quality, takes a few seconds), 'ga' = Classical Genetic Algorithm (balanced), 'greedy' = sub-second heuristic (best for CI/CD or small clusters under 10 services).

input_parameters.name: generations
input_parameters.description: Number of evolutionary iterations for QIEA or GA solvers. Higher = better quality, slower. Ignored for greedy.

input_parameters.name: seed
input_parameters.description: RNG seed for fully reproducible results. Same seed + same algorithm + same manifests always produces the same placement plan.

output_parameters.name: solver_name
output_parameters.description: Algorithm that produced the plan (QIEA, GA, GREEDY)

output_parameters.name: solve_time_s
output_parameters.description: Wall-clock time taken by the solver

output_parameters.name: latency_reduction_pct
output_parameters.description: Percentage cost reduction vs naive all-on-one-node baseline. Higher is better.

output_parameters.name: total_cost
output_parameters.description: H_total at this placement (lambda-weighted sum of all cost terms)

output_parameters.name: is_feasible
output_parameters.description: True when every service is assigned to exactly one node

output_parameters.name: assignments
output_parameters.description: Array of service-to-node assignments: each entry has service_name, node_name, and zone

actions.example_prompt: Optimize the staging cluster using the QIEA algorithm with 500 generations
actions.example_response_summary: QIEA reduced weighted latency cost by 38.2% in 4.7 seconds. api-gateway → node-1 (zone-a), order-service → node-2 (zone-b), ...

actions.description: Retrieves the most recent placement plan cached server-side for a cluster. Use this to review the last optimization result without re-running the solver.

input_parameters.name: cluster_id
input_parameters.description: The logical name of the cluster

actions.example_prompt: Show the last placement plan for staging-k8s
actions.example_response_summary: Last plan: QIEA, 38.2% reduction, 12 services assigned.
